data_description.base_url: Address of your operator's iBOK, for example https://ibok.example.pl

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up

data_description.scan_interval: Readings and invoices change at most once a day; a long interval is enough and keeps load off the operator's server. Fields named source_entity_<serial> are optional: set one only where some entity already holds that meter's reading, and a button appears for it.

submit_reading.name: Submit meter reading
submit_reading.description: Sends a meter reading to the operator. The value is checked against the range the portal reports before anything is sent.

meter_id.name: Meter ID
meter_id.description: Required only when several meters accept a reading.
